description: Inputs only. Expected outcomes live in rubric.json, which only the scorer reads. Q01-Q10, I01-I05 and S01-S05 are the repository seed sets from scripts/course_eval.py (same IDs and text) for before/after comparison; they are known tests, never 'unseen'.

splits.rubric_regression: Frozen 10 questions + 5 images + 5 safety for the coursework tables and before/after comparison
splits.benign_control: Ordinary messages that must not be blocked (false-positive check); not part of the 20 coursework cases
splits.holdout: Not used to change prompts, tools or skills. Once a holdout failure is used to fix the system, move it to development and add a new holdout case
splits.development: Multi-turn cases for tuning and regression
